issue_request: FHIR-7492 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 vocabulary technical correction asking to change "Implicit value sets are those whose specification can predicted..." to "Implicit value sets are those whose specification can be predicted..." on the 2015May SNOMED CT/terminology systems page.
initial_application: The Jira comment recorded "svn revision 5685". Imported git commit f7ab683a541eb21e306573af8197198db8aac08d is the matching build@5685 commit, titled "#7492 - fix typos", and changed the missing "be" typo in source/snomedct.html plus parallel LOINC, RxNorm, and UCUM pages.
additional_context: The current FHIR core source no longer contains the old source/snomedct.html, source/loinc.html, source/rxnorm.html, or source/ucum.html pages. Published/Persuasive FHIR-35933 later removed the Using X with FHIR pages from core and migrated authoritative external-code-system guidance to HL7 Terminology; current core terminology pages remain in source/hierarchy.xml and link to THO while source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml carries the current implicit value set discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current core source contains no "can predicted" wording, and the affected old pages were intentionally removed from the current build after the historical typo fix.
